integrity: The theorem and proof are given with their scope and explicit constructive witnesses. No independent assessment has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only cones arising from a bounded injective operator gauge on a one-dimensional extension; arbitrary ordered Banach spaces and the unrestricted normality-vs-Dini problem are not classified. Finite checks supplement, not replace, the complete analytic argument.
title: Weak Dini convergence for operator-gauge cones and closed range
